intro: Source of Power is an Undercity quest commissioned by Doctor Martin Felben, who seeks to capitalize on the turmoil within Dalaran. While the magical city is under siege by its own rogue constructs, Felben tasks adventurers with securing their arcane cores. His ambition is to synthesize Dalaran's magical tech with Forsaken fleshcraft to build arcane-infused abominations and catch the eye of the Dark Lady.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.
Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?
Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
